summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a 6-K announcing a non-binding letter of intent to sell its European activities via subsidiary IMC Holdings to Slil.com Holding Ltd., a related party controlled by CEO Oren Shuster. The consideration is the assumption of approximately CAD$10.5M in debt (CAD$7.5M retained liabilities plus CAD$3M short-term liabilities). No per-share price, premium, or implied value is stated. A special committee of independent directors was formed, and Beta Finance T.Y.S Ltd. was retained to assess fairness. The deal requires a definitive agreement, regulatory clearances, and is subject to an exclusivity period. This is a related-party divestiture aimed at deleveraging and focusing on Israeli operations; watch for shareholder opposition and regulatory scrutiny given the related-party nature.
